irac.issue: Whether a member of a Scheduled Caste can be a hereditary trustee of a temple and if so, whether he can perform Poojas and other religious functions.
irac.rule: A member of a Scheduled Caste can be a hereditary trustee of a temple but as a trustee, he does not have the right to perform Poojas and other religious functions which are restricted to a particular caste or class of people.
irac.application: The Supreme Court applied this rule to the case of Vatticherukuru Village Panchayat, holding that the 4th respondent, a member of a Scheduled Caste, could act as a hereditary trustee of the temple but could not perform Poojas and other religious functions.
irac.conclusion: The Supreme Court allowed the appeal, setting aside the High Court's judgment which had held that a member of a Scheduled Caste could not be a hereditary trustee of the temple.
